# Notta MCP Skill

This repository contains public discovery documentation and agent skill instructions for the official Notta MCP integration.

It is intended for MCP directories, agent skill registries, and users who need to discover or configure Notta MCP. It does not contain the Notta MCP server implementation, product source code, or bundled MCPB package.

The Notta MCP implementation is maintained by NOTTA K.K. / MindCruiser and distributed through the official channels listed below. The official MCP source repository is:

https://github.com/mindcruiser/notta-mcp

## What This Skill Does

Use this skill when an agent needs to help a user:

- Transcribe local audio or video files with Notta.
- Check Notta transcription status.
- Retrieve a Notta transcript by record ID.
- Search Notta transcription records.
- List Notta records and folders.

## Install Notta MCP

### Claude Desktop

Install the Notta MCP Desktop Extension / MCPB from the official Notta MCP distribution channel.

### Smithery

Use the Smithery server page:

https://smithery.ai/servers/notta/notta-mcp

## Available MCP Tools

- `auth_setup`
- `transcribe`
- `status`
- `view`
- `search`
- `list`

## Safety Boundaries

- Notta authorization must be completed through `auth_setup`.
- Local file transcription only works for user-approved directories.
- Maximum upload size is 2 GB.
- Maximum media duration is 4 hours.
- OAuth credentials and temporary upload credentials must not be exposed to the user or copied into prompts.
